settings.keepOriginalDesc: Back up original to 99-Archive/ingest-originals/ after conversion
settings.preferExternalDesc: Prefer anydoc / markitdown / pandoc when installed

settingsSlot.enableUiDesc: When off, drag-drop import still works (service retained)
settingsSlot.autoMdDesc: Off = copy files as-is only (after enqueue)
settingsSlot.confirmBeforeDesc: Off (default): auto-enqueue on drop/import. On: show pending list first, review then confirm
settingsSlot.openQueueDesc: Jump to Knowledge Ingest after auto-enqueue success
settingsSlot.preferExternalDesc: Use anydoc / markitdown / pandoc according to the preference below
settingsSlot.preferredConverterDesc: Auto: anydoc first, then markitdown / pandoc / built-in. If the preferred tool is missing or fails, the pipeline falls through instead of hard-failing.
settingsSlot.maxFileHint: Image-heavy PPT / PDF often exceed 25MB. Over the limit, originals are still imported but not auto-converted to Markdown.
settingsSlot.enhanceDesc: Default is anydoc (Office / ODF / RTF / EPUB / CSV / text PDF). HTML / email stay on dedicated converters. markitdown and pandoc remain optional.
settingsSlot.notYetChecked: Not yet checked; auto-detects on first open
settingsSlot.installHint: Install anydoc into app data with “Install to app”, or npm install -g @firecrawl/anydoc. Optional markitdown should use [all]. After a terminal install, click “Re-check”; results are cached.
settingsSlot.upgradeRule: anydoc upgrades are in-app (sidecar / host PATH) and do not need a Desktop re-pack. asar-bundled app code, Electron itself, and built-in JS converters (mammoth / unpdf / …) still require a new Desktop install.
